messages:
Sophie: quick one — PR #4821 is ready. tiny rename of RequestID -> requestID and a couple of JSON tag tweaks. CI is failing on formatting only, can someone take a quick look and approve if ok?
Mike: I can check in ~30m. can you paste the failing `gofumpt` output so I don't have to re-run CI?
Sophie: pasted below, it's basically the identifier case + an extra blank line in proto: ```diff
- RequestID
+ requestID
```
Also `make format` fixes locally for me.
Devops-bot: CI: fmt-check failed (exit 1) — https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/4821 (logs attached)
Alice: small nit: do we want the exported json tag to be `request_id` (snake_case) instead of `requestId`? our proto/json rules prefer snake_case for payloads.
Sophie: good call — updated tags to `request_id` in the last commit.
Ben: I can re-run the formatter and squash into one commit before the merge window if that helps.
Mike: please squash, and add a 1-line changelog to the PR description so QA knows what changed.
Sophie: done — squashed and pushed: "chore(api): rename RequestID -> requestID (json: request_id)" added to PR body.
Alice: LGTM once CI is green. @Mike please give final approve when you confirm there's no behavior change in serialization.
Mike: skimmed the diff — only serialization/tag changes, safe. approving now. :thumbsup:
Deploy-bot: Merge window opens in 1h; auto-merge will proceed once checks are green and approvals present.
Sophie: thanks all — I'll let it merge after green. I'll revert immediately if any regression shows up.
Ben: I'll watch the canary for ~10m post-merge and report back in #eng if anything odd appears.
Sophie: appreciated!
